verdict.rationale: LM Studio documents serving local models on OpenAI-like endpoints, locally and over the network, plus a REST API, CLI server start/stop, a headless llmster daemon, and on-demand model loading. These are exactly the mechanisms a coding agent uses to treat it as a backend. Community users confirm the OpenAI-compatible server is easy to spin up and that the headless flow makes local inference usable from real tools. Missing for 10: explicit documentation or hands-on reports of specific coding agents (e.g., IDE/CLI agents) connected to it, and evidence of tool-calling/function-calling support for agent workflows.
